title: Player changes their score PIN
description: From your profile, show, change, or regenerate the PIN used at score kiosks.

steps.title: Score PIN
steps.body: The Score PIN block is on your profile. Show PIN reveals it; Change PIN sets a new one; Regenerate PIN makes a random PIN.

steps.title: Change PIN
steps.body: Open the change form. Enter the new PIN twice and save — this capture does not submit a change.

steps.title: New PIN fields
steps.body: Type the PIN and confirmation, then save. Keep this PIN for kiosk score entry.
